inputs.name: NativePickerDefaultsService.constructor.rpc
inputs.description: The PickerRpc callback used for config/read and config/batchWrite requests. It is retained by the instance and its result or rejection is forwarded by the async methods.

inputs.name: NativePickerDefaultsService.constructor.catalogPath
inputs.description: Optional path value assigned to model_catalog_json when the current model provider is harness-claude. It is not validated or synthesized; if omitted, it remains undefined.

inputs.name: NativePickerDefaultsService.write.params
inputs.description: Data passed to write; edits must be an array or the method throws Error with message “Invalid configuration edits”. Model and model_reasoning_effort key paths are kept as copy-local edits, while other edits are sent to config/batchWrite.

inputs.name: NativePickerDefaultsService.write.options
inputs.description: Optional RPC options passed through to config/batchWrite. If omitted, undefined is forwarded.

inputs.name: NativePickerDefaultsService.read.params
inputs.description: Parameters passed through to config/read. The returned config is cloned before saved copy-local edits are overlaid.

inputs.name: NativePickerDefaultsService.read.options
inputs.description: Optional RPC options passed through to config/read. If omitted, undefined is forwarded.

outputs.name: NativePickerDefaultsService.write
outputs.description: A promise resolving to the PickerData returned by config/batchWrite after non-model edits are submitted; intercepted model edits are saved locally after that RPC succeeds.

outputs.name: NativePickerDefaultsService.read
outputs.description: A promise resolving to the config/read response with config cloned and saved model edits overlaid; a saved model also sets its provider, and the harness-claude provider adds reasoning effort, catalog path, and disabled web search.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by write when params.edits is not an array; the message is “Invalid configuration edits”.
